reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific, non-trivial dual-mechanism intervention (Ce doping in CoCrFeNi) that is not reported in any passage. It combines the known concepts of reactive element doping for oxidation resistance and grain-boundary segregation for low-temperature hardening into a single alloy design for wide-temperature-range tribology, which none of the passages suggest. The passages discuss other alloy systems, other dopants (W, Ti, V, MoS2, Y2O3, etc.), or structural approaches (nanohierarchical architecture), but none propose Ce addition to CoCrFeNi for in-situ CeO2 lubricious scale formation.
